rendering_rules: Keep operating, qualification, contracted, demonstration and proposed links visually distinct.
Country/regional aggregate flows must never imply a named mine or supplier shipped to a named U.S. customer.
All ingredients is the union of ingredient-tagged nodes/links, not all REEs.
Draw no missing oxide-to-metal or metal-to-magnet link by inference from common ownership.
No element-specific tonnage from total REO/TREO or finished-magnet mass.
Unknown destination stays unknown; country centroid is not facility geography.
Every connection has equal visual weight; no width represents tonnes.
Unknown conversion, batch, customer and geography remain visible gaps.
Operator/group names do not constitute a legal ownership/control audit.
gaps: No verified element-specific delivered-tonnage chain from Pela Ema through separation/metal/alloy to Stillwater.
Lynas existing metal-making counterparties not named in cited public source; Vietnam framework is proposed.
U.S. government Lynas binding LOI does not prove a delivered shipment; latest definitive delivery terms require later filing.
Named Chinese mine-to-U.S.-customer routes not verified. Use aggregate exports/trade layer separately.
Pilot/customer qualification of Dy/Tb oxide does not prove end-to-end qualified U.S. magnet availability.
Current Chinese-origin material supply connects to U.S. only in aggregate Tb trade evidence; no Bayan Obo/Maoniuping/Jiangxi named operator-to-U.S. customer route verified.
Solvay/Noveon contract directly names all three oxide products but metallization route and actual deliveries are missing.
